nodes.text: Mama Achieng's kiosk. A wooden shack painted sky-blue, stacked with airtime scratch cards, sweets in jars, and a hand-painted sign: MAMA ACHIENG' ENTERPRISES. Below it, a new green banner — SAFARICOM M-PESA AGENT.
Inside, a Safaricom agent kit sits on the counter — a branded float book, posters, and a laminated instruction sheet. Mama Achieng' stares at her phone like it's a suspicious relative.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: "Bonyeza OK kisha..." Kisha nini? This menu is going in circles.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: They give you a kit but no human being to explain? Ati 'user-friendly.' User-hostile is what it is.
She notices you watching from the doorway.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Oh, ni wewe. Your mother sent you? Sit. Don't touch anything.
She goes back to squinting at the phone screen. You can see she's stuck on the M-Pesa registration menu.

choices.text: "Mama, nikusaidie? I can show you." — Help her patiently.
"Ehh Mama, si you said M-Pesa is nonsense?" — Tease her.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Mama, nikusaidie? I heard about this in school — it's not hard, actually.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: You? You know about this thing?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Okay, first — go to the SIM Toolkit menu. See? Safaricom is there.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: SIM... Tool... kit. Okay. I see it. Safaricom. M-PESA. Now what?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Now enter your PIN — the one they gave you. Then we try a test: send ten bob to my number.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Ten shillings to YOU? From MY float? Aii...

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: It's a test! I'll send it back. Promise.
She enters the number. Presses Send. A long pause. Then — a confirmation message. Your phone buzzes.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: ...It went? Just like that?

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Hmm. Maybe you're not completely useless after all, {player_name}. Asante.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Ehh Mama, si you said M-Pesa is nonsense? 'Pesa in the air,' you said. Now you're the agent?

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Wewe! I said I don't trust it — I didn't say I won't sell it. Business is business. Ukiona kuku wa bure, shika.
nodes.gloss: You! ... If you see a free chicken, grab it.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: So you need help or...?

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: I don't need help from a child who still gets pocket money from his mother. Sit. Watch. Learn.
She mutters her way through the menu. Backs out twice. Tries again. Then — a confirmation beep. She hides a smile, but you catch it.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: There. Done. Without your help. Some of us don't give up at the first problem.
Your phone buzzes. A text from Mum.
[SMS from Mum]: "{player_name}, tuma fare kwa Bibi. 200 bob. Use that M-Pesa thing — the kiosk should have it now. Bibi's number: 0722-XXX-XXX."
Your first M-Pesa transaction. You open the SIM Toolkit. Navigate to Send Money. Enter Bibi's number. 200. Confirm. PIN.
[M-PESA] Confirmed. Ksh200.00 sent to ELIZABETH WANJIKU 0722-XXX-XXX on 07/03/07 at 11:42 AM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh85.00. Transaction cost Ksh30.00.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Bibi yako amepata?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Imefika. Just like that. No bus, no queue.

nodes.speaker: mama_achieng
nodes.text: Hmm. Haba na haba hujaza kibaba.
nodes.gloss: Little by little fills the measure.

nodes.text: For a moment, neither of you says anything. The green M-Pesa banner flaps in the afternoon breeze. Something just changed — small, but real.
